# TPC-DS-OBT Q94

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT sale_id) AS "order count",
  SUM(ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",
  SUM(net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    ship_date_d_date BETWEEN '1999-2-01' AND (
      CAST('1999-2-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '60 DAY'
    )
    AND obt.ship_date_sk = ship_date_d_date_sk
    AND obt.ship_addr_sk = ship_addr_ca_address_sk
    AND ship_addr_ca_state = '0'
    AND obt.web_site_sk = web_site_web_site_sk
    AND web_site_web_company_name = 'pri'
    AND EXISTS(
      SELECT
        *
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
      WHERE
        (
          obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id AND obt.warehouse_sk <> obt.warehouse_sk
        )
        AND channel = 'web'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT
        *
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
      WHERE
        obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id AND obt.has_return = 'Y' AND obt.channel = 'web'
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'web'
ORDER BY
  COUNT(DISTINCT sale_id)
LIMIT 100
```
